browserMethod: Desktop Chromium and Pixel 7 emulation against the public HTTPS origin, with normal TLS verification and Cache-Control/Pragma no-cache headers to exclude cached pre-cutover proxy responses.

deploymentAudit.method: HEAD every generated HTML route plus robots, sitemap and representative rewritten URLs; GET/decompress/byte-compare representative data. curl sends Cache-Control/Pragma no-cache and retains configured TLS verification and proxy trust. This is HTTP/data verification, not a live browser interaction test.

vercelProjectDeletion: Requires the owner to confirm deletion in the Vercel dashboard; the connector cannot access the rootulp team.
vercelProCancellation: Not performed. Project deletion does not cancel the Pro subscription.
limits: These are recorded functional and HTTP/data checks for the deployed build, not field Core Web Vitals or a guarantee about every user and browser.
